environment.method: No hyperfine on this VM. python3 subprocess harness, time.perf_counter_ns() wall clock per spawn (process start included); median + nearest-rank p95. Read items n=50 (3 warmups), stateful items n=30, v1 n=30.

results.name: Gate calculation: gate evaluate qa (compute + persist verdict)
results.notes: Primary figure is gate evaluate qa (reads facts, decides, writes gate_results). On this migrated feature the verdict is 'blocked' (qa evidence missing), so the CLI exits non-zero; timing covers the full compute+write path regardless. gate status (read-only read of already-evaluated verdicts) timed separately, see gate_status_* fields. The write path performs several store transactions and is fsync-bound on this VM's home volume (btrfs, the same volume as the default ~/.beacon/beacon.db); the read-only gate status path passes the same threshold.

results.name: Orchestrator iteration scheduling (goal tick, recording executor)
results.notes: Each sample: untimed setup creates a fresh goal run, then one timed beacon goal tick --executor recording (placeholder executor, no real agent work) advancing the run one stage. Timing = CLI spawn + store + engine scheduling for that one tick; agent execution excluded by construction. The tick persists stage/lifecycle/checkpoint rows in several transactions, so on this VM's btrfs home volume it is fsync-bound (a tmpfs store measured materially lower in manual probes but would not represent the default ~/.beacon store location).
